finding: A camera screenshot was taken before the aircraft scene had loaded. The flow-stage ready callback could mark the asset ready without loading the hangar.
correction: Hangar asset readiness is signaled only by the non-flow scene. Camera checks wait for that signal and require more than 30 distinct sampled canvas colors in every view.
scope: Local browser visuals only. The initial DOM tests passed despite the blank view; they were insufficient and were strengthened.
